about: Pin archive set mutants (internal/pinset/pinset.go, compile-speed CS3): a set's name must key every field of its pin and target, and a fetched set must be refused unless its tar has the lock's sha256. TestPinSetNameKeysEveryInput changes each key field in turn; TestRefusedArchiveFallsBack serves sets whose bytes are not the locked ones and builds Go (full tier).

mutants.name: cs-pin-key-omits-patch
mutants.rule: A set's name keys the IR patch digest: a set compiled by the stock compile, or by another patch, is another set.

mutants.name: cs-pin-key-omits-flags
mutants.rule: A set's name keys the compile flags (-trimpath, cgo off, -shared, the tags): a set compiled with other flags is another set.

mutants.name: cs-pin-digest-unchecked
mutants.rule: A fetched set is installed only when its tar's sha256 is the lock's; otherwise it is refused with one line and the build compiles what it would have held.
